title: 6sense Review (2026)
intro: 6sense is evaluated here as sales intelligence software — Enterprise account-based marketing and sales intelligence platform that combines predictive buying intent, contact/account data, and go-to-market orchestration for mid-market and enterprise revenue teams. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s sales-intelligence methodology (contact data, prospecting, enrichment, email outreach, CRM sync, usability, reporting, value). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose 6sense when enterprise predictive intent and ABM account prioritization are the primary jobs and you can run a custom-quote evaluation.
verdict: Choose 6sense when enterprise predictive intent and ABM account prioritization are the primary jobs and you can run a custom-quote evaluation. Compare Demandbase for competing ABM orchestration, ZoomInfo for deeper enterprise contact databases, Apollo for self-serve data+engagement, and Clay for modern multi-provider enrichment workflows. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: 6sense documents contact and account intelligence as part of the sales platform, but its center of gravity is predictive intent and ABM prioritization rather than being the category’s deepest standalone contact database.
Account and buyer prioritization, in-market signals, and sales workflows are first-party strengths for enterprise prospecting motions that start from accounts, not only people searches.
Enrichment of accounts/contacts and buying-stage context is core to the predictive ABM story — enrichment serves orchestration, not just CSV fill.

Sales engagement assist and orchestration exist, but native multichannel sequencing is not the primary product job versus Outreach/Salesloft-class tools — score reflects assist depth, not sequencer leadership.
Native CRM and marketing-automation connectors (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, and sales engagement tools) are first-party documented for enterprise stacks.
Powerful but enterprise-packaged: predictive models, credits, and ABM admin raise the learning curve versus self-serve SMB SI tools.
Account journey, pipeline influence, and revenue-team reporting are positioned as first-class for ABM and sales intelligence buyers.
No published list prices and enterprise packaging make value opaque for SMB buyers; teams that will run predictive ABM at scale may still justify cost — score reflects transparency and accessibility.

faq.question: Is 6sense a CRM?
faq.answer: No. 6sense is sales intelligence / prospecting software. Keep a CRM of record (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, etc.) and use 6sense for discovery, enrichment, intent, or account prioritization as applicable.

faq.question: How is 6sense priced?
faq.answer: Custom-quote Sales Intelligence packages (SI + Credits, SI + Predictive, SI + Credits + Predictive). No published seat dollar prices on 6sense sales pricing. Confirm current modules and credits with 6sense.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test 6sense?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage.
